title.en: Music of the archipelago & the world

body.id: Bumi punya tujuh benua: Asia, Afrika, Amerika Utara, Amerika Selatan, Antarktika, Eropa, dan Australia. Di antaranya ada lima samudra.
body.en: Earth has seven continents: Asia, Africa, North America, South America, Antarctica, Europe and Australia. Five oceans lie between them.

body.id: Indonesia berada di antara dua benua, Asia dan Australia, dan dua samudra, Hindia dan Pasifik. Garis khatulistiwa melintasi negeri kita.
body.en: Indonesia lies between two continents, Asia and Australia, and two oceans, the Indian and the Pacific. The equator crosses our country.

body.id: Pada 1967 Indonesia ikut mendirikan ASEAN bersama Malaysia, Filipina, Singapura, dan Thailand. Kini anggotanya 11 negara.
body.en: In 1967 Indonesia helped found ASEAN with Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore and Thailand. Today it has 11 members.

title.en: Music of the archipelago & the world

body.id: Alat musik berbunyi dengan cara berbeda: dipukul (gamelan, kendang), dipetik (sasando, gitar), digoyang (angklung), atau ditiup (suling).
body.en: Instruments sound in different ways: struck (gamelan, kendang drum), plucked (sasando, guitar), shaken (angklung) or blown (suling flute).

body.id: Tiap daerah punya bunyi khas: sasando dari Pulau Rote, angklung dari Jawa Barat, dan tari Saman dari Aceh yang memakai tepukan tubuh.
body.en: Each region has its own sound: the sasando from Rote Island, the angklung from West Java, and Aceh's Saman dance, played with body percussion.

body.id: Musik juga berkelana: keroncong berakar dari musik Portugis abad ke-16, dan gamelan pernah memikat komponis di Eropa.
body.en: Music travels too: keroncong has roots in 16th-century Portuguese music, and gamelan once captivated composers in Europe.

meaning.en: The largest continent?

model_answer.id: Asia adalah benua terbesar, baik luasnya maupun jumlah penduduknya.
model_answer.en: Asia is the largest continent, by area and by population.

meaning.id: Indonesia diapit Samudra Hindia dan Samudra ____.
meaning.en: Indonesia lies between the Indian Ocean and the ____ Ocean.

model_answer.id: Indonesia diapit Samudra Hindia dan Samudra Pasifik.
model_answer.en: Indonesia lies between the Indian and Pacific Oceans.

meaning.id: Pulau ini kita bagi dengan Papua Nugini.
meaning.en: We share this island with Papua New Guinea.

model_answer.id: Pulau Papua (Nugini) dibagi Indonesia dan Papua Nugini.
model_answer.en: The island of New Guinea is shared by Indonesia and Papua New Guinea.

meaning.id: Musim di Indonesia atau empat musim?
meaning.en: Indonesia's seasons, or four seasons?

text.en: Four seasons, far from the equator

model_answer.id: Indonesia punya musim hujan dan kemarau. Negara yang jauh dari khatulistiwa punya musim semi, panas, gugur, dan dingin.
model_answer.en: Indonesia has a rainy and a dry season. Countries far from the equator have spring, summer, autumn and winter.

meaning.id: Tugu Khatulistiwa di Pontianak. Ketuk pulaunya.
meaning.en: The Equator Monument is in Pontianak. Tap its island.

model_answer.id: Pontianak di Kalimantan Barat dilalui garis khatulistiwa.
model_answer.en: Pontianak in West Kalimantan sits on the equator.

meaning.en: ASEAN was founded in Bangkok in 1967.

model_answer.id: Deklarasi Bangkok ditandatangani 8 Agustus 1967 oleh lima negara pendiri ASEAN.
model_answer.en: The Bangkok Declaration was signed on 8 August 1967 by ASEAN's five founding countries.

meaning.en: Neighbour → the island we share.

model_answer.id: Kalimantan dengan Malaysia (dan Brunei), Papua dengan Papua Nugini, Timor dengan Timor-Leste.
model_answer.en: Kalimantan with Malaysia (and Brunei), New Guinea with Papua New Guinea, Timor with Timor-Leste.

meaning.id: Ini hanya bisa dibuat di musim dingin.
meaning.en: You can only make this in winter.

model_answer.id: Manusia salju dibuat dari salju, di negara yang mengalami musim dingin bersalju.
model_answer.en: A snowman is made of snow, in countries with snowy winters.

meaning.en: Largest continent first.

model_answer.id: Asia, Afrika, Eropa, lalu Australia.
model_answer.en: Asia, Africa, Europe, then Australia.

meaning.en: The ASEAN Secretariat is in…

model_answer.id: Sekretariat ASEAN berkantor di Jakarta.
model_answer.en: The ASEAN Secretariat is based in Jakarta.

meaning.en: Countries and their continents.

model_answer.id: Mesir di Afrika, Prancis di Eropa, Brasil di Amerika Selatan, Kanada di Amerika Utara.
model_answer.en: Egypt is in Africa, France in Europe, Brazil in South America, Canada in North America.

model_answer.id: Buat peta dunia dari kertas warna: gunting tujuh benua, tempel di kertas biru sebagai laut, lalu beri tanda tempat Indonesia.
model_answer.en: Make a world map from coloured paper: cut out the seven continents, stick them on blue paper for the sea, then mark where Indonesia is.

meaning.en: The continent that is almost all ice?

model_answer.id: Antarktika, di sekitar Kutub Selatan, hampir seluruhnya tertutup es.
model_answer.en: Antarctica, around the South Pole, is almost all covered in ice.

meaning.id: Pulau ini kita bagi dengan Malaysia.
meaning.en: We share this island with Malaysia.

model_answer.id: Kalimantan dibagi Indonesia, Malaysia, dan Brunei Darussalam.
model_answer.en: Borneo is shared by Indonesia, Malaysia and Brunei Darussalam.

meaning.id: Di Indonesia ada musim hujan dan musim kemarau.
meaning.en: Indonesia has a rainy season and a dry season.

model_answer.id: Indonesia dekat khatulistiwa, jadi musimnya musim hujan dan musim kemarau.
model_answer.en: Indonesia is near the equator, so its seasons are a rainy one and a dry one.

meaning.en: Struck, plucked or shaken?

model_answer.id: Gamelan dan kendang dipukul, sasando dan gitar dipetik, angklung digoyang.
model_answer.en: Gamelan and kendang are struck, sasando and guitar are plucked, angklung is shaken.

meaning.id: Alat musik petik dari Pulau Rote.
meaning.en: A plucked instrument from Rote Island.

model_answer.id: Sasando dari Pulau Rote, NTT. Wadah bunyinya dari daun lontar.
model_answer.en: The sasando is from Rote Island, East Nusa Tenggara. Its sound shell is lontar palm leaf.

meaning.id: Tari Saman dari Aceh. Ketuk pulaunya.
meaning.en: The Saman dance is from Aceh. Tap its island.

model_answer.id: Tari Saman berasal dari suku Gayo di Aceh, Sumatra.
model_answer.en: The Saman dance comes from the Gayo people of Aceh, Sumatra.

meaning.id: Masuk daftar warisan budaya UNESCO pada 2021.
meaning.en: Added to UNESCO's heritage list in 2021.

model_answer.id: Gamelan masuk daftar warisan budaya takbenda UNESCO pada 2021.
model_answer.en: Gamelan joined UNESCO's intangible cultural heritage list in 2021.

meaning.en: Art form → where it's from.

model_answer.id: Saman dari Aceh, angklung dari Jawa Barat, sasando dari Rote (NTT), wayang kulit dari Jawa dan Bali.
model_answer.en: Saman from Aceh, angklung from West Java, sasando from Rote (East Nusa Tenggara), wayang kulit from Java and Bali.

meaning.en: Saman dancers make their sound with…

text.id: Tepukan tangan, dada, dan paha, juga nyanyian
text.en: Clapping hands, chest and thighs, and singing

model_answer.id: Saman memakai tubuh sebagai alat musik: tepuk tangan, tepuk dada dan paha, serta nyanyian.
model_answer.en: Saman uses the body as the instrument: clapping, slapping chest and thighs, and singing.

meaning.en: Earliest first.

text.id: Gamelan Jawa dimainkan di Pameran Dunia Paris (1889)
text.en: Javanese gamelan plays at the Paris World's Fair (1889)

text.id: Musik pelaut Portugis tiba, akar keroncong (abad ke-16)
text.en: Portuguese sailors' music arrives, the roots of keroncong (1500s)

model_answer.id: Keroncong (abad ke-16), gamelan di Paris (1889), lalu dangdut populer (1970-an).
model_answer.en: Keroncong (1500s), gamelan in Paris (1889), then dangdut's rise (1970s).

meaning.id: Nama dangdut meniru bunyi alat ini.
meaning.en: Dangdut is named after this instrument's sound.

model_answer.id: Nama dangdut meniru bunyi gendangnya: "dang" dan "dut".
model_answer.en: Dangdut is named after its drum sound: "dang" and "dut".

meaning.id: Angklung besar atau kecil: mana bernada lebih rendah?
meaning.en: Big or small angklung: which sounds lower?

model_answer.id: Tabung bambu yang lebih besar dan panjang berbunyi lebih rendah.
model_answer.en: Bigger, longer bamboo tubes make lower notes.

meaning.en: Wayang kulit is played with this music.

model_answer.id: Wayang kulit diiringi gamelan, dan satu dalang menyuarakan semua tokohnya.
model_answer.en: Wayang kulit is accompanied by gamelan, and one dalang voices every character.

meaning.en: Keroncong has roots in the music of ____ sailors.

model_answer.id: Keroncong berakar dari musik Portugis; Kampung Tugu di Jakarta masih memainkannya.
model_answer.en: Keroncong has Portuguese roots; Kampung Tugu in Jakarta still plays it.

model_answer.id: Buat alat musik gelas: isi beberapa gelas dengan air yang tingginya berbeda. Ketuk pelan dengan sendok, dengarkan, lalu susun dari nada rendah ke tinggi.
model_answer.en: Make a glass instrument: fill a few glasses with different amounts of water. Tap each gently with a spoon, listen, then line them up from low to high.

meaning.en: Which instrument is plucked?

model_answer.id: Gitar dibunyikan dengan dipetik.
model_answer.en: A guitar is played by plucking.

meaning.id: Angklung dari Jawa Barat. Ketuk pulaunya.
meaning.en: The angklung is from West Java. Tap its island.

model_answer.id: Angklung berasal dari Jawa Barat, di Pulau Jawa.
model_answer.en: The angklung comes from West Java, on Java.

meaning.en: Keroncong has its roots in Japanese music.

model_answer.id: Keroncong berakar dari musik Portugis, bukan Jepang.
model_answer.en: Keroncong has Portuguese roots, not Japanese.

items.source: Encyclopaedia Britannica, "Claude Debussy" (britannica.com); Richard Mueller, "Javanese Influence on Debussy's Fantaisie and Beyond", 19th-Century Music 10/2 (1986).

model_answer.id: Pada Pameran Dunia Paris 1889, komponis Prancis Claude Debussy mendengar gamelan Jawa. Bunyinya memengaruhi musiknya, misalnya karya piano "Pagodes" (1903).
model_answer.en: At the 1889 Paris World's Fair, the French composer Claude Debussy heard a Javanese gamelan. Its sound shaped his music, for example the piano piece "Pagodes" (1903).

meaning.id: ASEAN berdiri pada 1967. Pada tahun 2027, ASEAN berumur berapa tahun?
meaning.en: ASEAN was founded in 1967. How old will it be in 2027?
